findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation "Add descriptive alt text to the informative images that lack it and empty alt to the decorative ones" lacks a specific data anchor (no image selector, count or URL) and is therefore generic.

Priority 2 recommendation "Order headings without skipping levels" does not reference any specific heading element, page or count, making it a domain‑level suggestion rather than an audit‑anchored fix.

Priority 3 recommendation "Replace the obvious landmark containers (header, nav, main, footer, aside) with their semantic elements and give the remaining containers meaningful class names" is not tied to any specific selector or page instance, thus it is a generic recommendation.
Optional enhancement “BreadcrumbList” proposes adding breadcrumb JSON‑LD without citing any missing markup on the audited pages, making it a generic suggestion.

Optional enhancement “SpeakableSpecification” recommends defining CSS selectors for article content but does not reference any specific page or element from the audit data, so it is a hollow recommendation.
Optional enhancement “Content‑Signal directives” suggests adding a robots.txt directive without pointing to an existing missing rule in the audit, rendering it a generic recommendation.
